name: imgradient_direction
expr: [gm,gd] = imgradient(A); gm33 = gm(3,3); gd33 = gd(3,3); [gx,gy] = imgradientxy(A); gx33 = gx(3,3); gy33 = gy(3,3); [gmp,gdp] = imgradient(A,'prewitt'); gdp33 = gdp(3,3); [gxp,gyp] = imgradientxy(A,'prewitt'); gxp33 = gxp(3,3); gyp33 = gyp(3,3);
comment: imgradient/imgradientxy sobel+prewitt gradient SIGN vs MATLAB R2025b. DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31 (toolbox pivot, toolboxes/image): the 2-D sobel/prewitt kernels were sign-flipped (kx=[1 0 -1;...]) so imgradientxy returned negated Gx/Gy (Gx=-40 vs MATLAB +40 for a left->right-increasing ramp) and imgradient's Gdir=atan2(-Gy,Gx) was 180 deg off (168.69 vs MATLAB -11.31). Gmag was unaffected (sign-invariant); 'central'/'intermediate' were already correct; the 3-D imgradientxyz kernels were already MATLAB-signed. Fix flips kx/ky to MATLAB's hx=[-1 0 1;-2 0 2;-1 0 1]. reshape(1:25,5,5) at (3,3): sobel Gmag=40.7921563, Gdir=-11.3099325, Gx=40, Gy=8; prewitt Gdir=-11.3099325, Gx=30, Gy=6. The 2-arg imgradient(Gx,Gy) input form remains deferred. covers:[imgradient,imgradientxy].
